fact: Irregular periods can have several possible causes. A qualified healthcare professional can help determine the cause.

myth: Severe period pain should always be ignored.
fact: Severe or worsening pain that affects daily life is worth discussing with a healthcare professional.

myth: Every health symptom has one obvious cause.
fact: Many symptoms can have multiple possible causes, so professional evaluation may sometimes be needed.

myth: Mental health concerns are simply a lack of willpower.
fact: Mental wellbeing can be affected by many biological, psychological and social factors.

myth: You need to know your diagnosis before seeing a doctor.
fact: You can describe your symptoms and concerns without knowing the diagnosis.
